title: El coste social
goal: Read how spending cuts and inflation eroded real wages and fueled the informal sector and rising poverty across the 1980s, including Venezuela's deadly February 1989 Caracazo riots.

items: Explain how spending cuts and inflation eroded real wages.
Describe what happened to the informal sector during this decade.
State how poverty changed by 1990 compared to the late 1970s.
Explain what triggered the Caracazo in February 1989.
Use en detrimento de to name who bears a policy's cost.
I can explain how spending cuts and inflation eroded real wages.
I can describe what happened to the informal sector during this decade.
I can state how poverty changed by 1990 compared to the late 1970s.
I can explain what triggered the Caracazo in February 1989.
I can use en detrimento de to name who bears a policy's cost.
